class.name: GameplayPredictionState
class.brief_description: Authoritative or predicted state for the basic deterministic movement model.
class.description: GameplayPredictionState stores position, velocity, the last input sequence represented by the state, and the server sample time. It is a small extension point for the GF-5 sample model, not a general physics snapshot.

method.name: duplicate_state
method.description: Returns an independent copy suitable for history or interpolation.

members.member: Last input sequence incorporated into this state.
Authority sample time used by remote interpolation.
Finite velocity produced by the model.
